balls.text: full just outside off, Murali drives inside-out along the ground, but it goes straight to AB de Villiers at mid-off, the batsmen decided to go for two anyway, de Villiers lobs the ball to the keeper and Murali is caught well out of his crease
driven back past the bowler, towards mid-on, Murali decides against the single
Nannes gets another one, familiar mode of dismissal for Chennai today, a huge swat gets a top edge which results in a simple catch to Gambhir at cover
another boundary for Jakati, that was a yorker just outside off, Jakati had backed away and he managed to slap that wide off the third man fielder for four
full toss on legstump, yet another outside edge off a big swing, and it narrowly misses offstump before running away for four
Murali is again backing away, carves it towards cover and gets a single
Murali gets off the mark with a heave that flies towards third man
gives himself room, gets a thick inside edge as well as a single near square leg
the procession continues, Balaji is the one to go this , fuller from Nehra, Balaji tries to loft over mid-on but can only spoon it to AB de Villiers
bangs in the bouncer, Balaji goes for a flamboyant pull but doesn't get hold of the ball
Balaji does a van der Merwe, looking to hit it towards midwicket and gets it towards wide long-off
full on offstump, squeezed out towards point for a single
fullish on legstump, Jakati jams it towards mid-on to take a single
Jakati backs away to give himself room and slap a back-of-length ball through the covers, but doesn't get bat on it
the hat-trick ball was a wide down the leg side

Dhoni falls and Chennai's innings is unravelling here, Nannes is on a hat-trick, Dhoni tries to pull but gets a top edge to the 145 kmh delivery, and it swirls towards Gautam Gambhir at cover for a simple catch

Nannes strikes, Oram is gone, it was similar to the previous delivery, Oram swings mightily again, gets bat this time, but AB de Villiers keeps his composure to take a difficult catch at wide long-on, he was on the edge of the boundary there
Oram goes for a big heave to a short, outside-off delivery, misses and that's a dot ball
overpitched on middle, a trademark Dhoni shot has the ball racing past the bowler, timing was not good enough though and long-off can come around and cut if off to keep the batsmen down to two
this time he drives it with soft hands towards mid-off to get himself an easy single
length ball just outside off, Oram wanted to run the ball off the face of the bat, but was beaten
low full toss on middle and off, an ungainly shot from Dhoni gets it away to mid-on
full on middle stump, whipped to long-on by Oram, just a single as the fielder is deep
Bhatia starts with a slower legcutter, 99kmh, dabbed towards mid-on for a single
this is better from Nehra, back of a length, just outside off, Dhoni shuffles across and works it behind square leg for a single
that's a wide down the legside, attempts a slower ball, but line was awry
slightly shorter this time, Oram backs away to give himself room and dabs it behind point for a single
good line from Nehra, in the channel outside off, poked towards backward point by Oram
back of a length on offstump, Dhoni pushes it off the backfoot towards cover, batsmen scamper a quick single

big, big wicket for Delhi, Albie Morkel is gone, Nehra's bouncer gets him another wicket, Albie went for the pull but it could only manage a top edge which hangs in the air long enough for Nehra himself to get under it
low full toss on the pads, easy pickings for Morkel, he flicks it away to square leg for a boundary
slower ball, pitched up on a length and Dhoni pats it back

knocked over! Badrinath again starts to walk across the stumps in an attempt to paddle the ball down to fine leg but this time Bhatia is alert and slides in a quick yorker that sneaks between bat and leg to disturb the furniture
pitched up outside off stump and Morkel plants his foot forward, clubbing that down to long-off
where's he going? Walks right across and outside off stump and plays a big shot to a slower ball, resulting in a top edge that pops up and lands safely at short third man
thick inside edge to deep midwicket off a might swing
slower ball out the back of the hand, full and outside leg stump, Badrinath makes room and swings and the ball goes between his leg and the sticks for four byes
full on the pads and he sweeps to short fine leg
short ball, wide too, cannot bowl that length on this pitch and Badrinath crashes it very hard past point
driven wide of long-on, enough time for the batsmen to get two
swiped to long-on off the backfoot for a single to get off the mark
driven towards covers towards a single which brings Albie Morkel on strike
full ball on offstump, squeezed towards short third man
slower offcutter from Bhatia, pushed back towards the bowler by Badrinath
length ball, defended towards the offside by Badrinath

Raina holes out to midwicket, whoah didn't Delhi need that breakthrough, Raina was down the track to laucnh the ball over his favourite midwicket region, he hits it well but it finds Dilshan about a yard in from the boundary, coolly taken by Dilshan
fuller, Raina was looking for a big one, doesn't get hold of it and it skims along to long-on, Raina gets a couple
Raina gets in on the act, slightly short and on the pads, swatted away off the backfoot for four to midwicket
wide outside off and hammered by Badrinath past point, that's yet another boundary, what did he drink during the break?
no ducking under this one, Badrinath hooks it powerfully over the square leg boundary, he continues to race along
this time Sangwan tests Badrinath with a bouncer, the batsmen ducks under it
Sangwan responds with the slower ball, angling across Badrinath, who was looking to glide it to third man but is beaten
Badrinath has been energised by that break, this time he gets a boundary to fine leg after Sangwan sends a short one down the leg side
driven to mid-off off the backfoot by Raina for a single
Raina goes for an inside-out egde shot, doesn't get hold of it, luckily for him it lands short of extra cover
nudged to square leg for a single
Badrinath has come out far more aggressive after the break, this time he jumps down the ground and slams it over covers for a boundary
punched firmly back past the bowler by Raina
short ball on midde and leg, whipped away off the backfoot towards midwicket
tossed up by Dilshan, Badrinath gets onto the front foot and swats it over wide ling-on, great start for Chennai after the break
similar delivery, driven to long-off for a single
length ball on offstump, Badrinath defends it off the front foot
follows it up with a boundary, on the pads, swept fine past the fielder in the circle
Bang! short again, Raina doesn't miss out, his powerful sweep clears the midwicket boundary comfortably
a bit of width for Badrinath, slapped behind point for a single
another tidy over comes to an end, as Badrinath dabs the ball towards the cover for a single
on middle and leg, worked to fine leg by Raina for a single
driven to long-off this time by Badrinath, who's taking his time to settle
defended back down the pitch off the backfoot
outside off, Raina sweeps, gets an edge which goes to the keeper's right for a single
drags it short, on offstump, Raina can't capitalise, he can only punch it down to the bowler
ends the over with another dot ball, tapped firmly back to the bowler off the front foot
good over so far from  Mishra, again it's on a length, Badrinath pushes it towards the off
strays onto Raina''s pads, clipped to short fine leg for a single
this time he gets a single by pushing it to  mid-off
again on a length, around offstump, defended cautiously off the front foot
starts with an on-target delivery, watchfully defended by Badrinath
another comfortable single, this time to long-on
wider outside off, Raina crunches it down towards long-off for an easy single
holds back the length a bit, it stops on Raina a bit, and he nearly popped it back to the bowler
full on off, Raina digs it out towards point
a touch short, Raina is onto the backfoot in a flash, carves it towards long-on, fetches him a couple
on the pads, Badrinathgets a single but working it towards midwicket

Raina ends the over with a boundary, slightly overpitched, Raina lofts it over mid-off, it looked like he had got too much under it and hit it too high but it was long enough to go over the boundary, nice way to get off the mark
much better this time, back of a length on offstump, Raina pushes it towards point, but there's no run there
Sangwan follows up his wicket-taking ball with a wide down the leg side
Sangwan gets him this time, Hayden tries a repeat of the previous stroke, mishit towards long-on, where Ab de Villiers takes a  good, low catch
nothing streaky about this shot though, typical bullying Hayden, he comes down the pitch and swipes it towards midwicket, it lands about a couple of yards inside the boundary
short and outside off, Hayden throws his bat hard at it, looking to go over point but gets a thick edge and the ball hums over the keeper's gloves for a boundary
full outside off, Hayden squeezes it past extra cover for a couple
the in-form Raina is greeted with a bouncer, left alone to the keeper

short ball does the trick for Nehra, Vijay's gone, the batsmen went for a pull, it got a thick top edge and the ball swirled towards extra cover, for a moment it seemed Rajat Bhatia and David Warner might collide attempting the catch, Bhatia takes a simple catch in the end after clashing with Warner
this time it's outside off, Vijay crashes it towards cover, but again the placement wasn't great, so Vijay doesn't get a run
short ball, tries to pull, gets a top edge, flies to deep sqyare leg, not near a fielder luckily for Hayden
The pressure's on Nehra, he sends a wide down the leg side
Smash! the first six of the game, length ball, Hayden was down the track and to the pitch of the ball, and he crunched it over cover, massive
ends the over with a boundary, clipped off his pads and races away to the midwicket boundary
Hayden shows who's the boss by wlatzing down the track and whacking the ball down the ground, cut off at mid-off
Hayden's hurt himself here, going for a cheeky paddle past short fine leg, misses the ball completely and is hit in the midriff, Hayden goes down on the pitch
this time a single for Vijay, dabbed off his thigh towards sqaure leg
length ball on offstump, lofted over towards midwicket to get a couple
Sangwan starts with a poor ball, down the leg side, Hayden tries to help it past short fine leg, but doesn't get enpough bat on it and it dribbles towards square leg
a touch overpitched this time, Hayden wanted to launch it to long-on, doesn't quite get hold of it and it rolls towards Dilshan at mid-on, he misfields allowing the batsmen a single
another thick outside edge to third man, this time by Vijay, who was pushing at a ball angling across him
this time Hadyen stays in the crease, and getsa thick outside edfe towards third man for a single
146.4 kmh from Nannes, Hayden was charging down the track, but it was wide outside off and out of Hadyen's reach
back of a length around offstump this time, Hayden pinned to the backfoot by the bounce, withdraws his bat at the last moment
Nannes starts the over with a bouncer, 136kmph, Hayden saw it coming early though and weaved out of the way of that one comfortably
length ball on off, vijay is quickly onto the front foot and goes for a booming on-drive, a bit of a mishit and it goes to mid-on on the bounce
length ball, spearing into Hayden's pad, the batsman just taps it with soft hands towards mid-on, time enough to get a single
this one's again on legstump, doesn't rise as much as the previous delivery, only about waist high, pulled away to deep fine leg
Nehra surprises Vijay with a quick bouncer, Vijay was looking to get on the front foot, gets a top edge on an attempted pull and the ball sails over the keeper's head for a boundary
slightly fuller, good looking cover drive from Vijay, placement isn't good so he doesn't get any runs
good start by Nehra, nice line, tight around the offstump, just back of a length, pushes Vijay to the backfoot, and the batsmen defends it back down the pitch
pushes the pace past the 140kmh mark, short and pretty wide outside off, Hayden isn't interested, any wider and that would have been an illegal delivery
he doesn't let this ine go, slightly ovepritched, it's drilled down the ground past the bowler, a powerful hit along the ground for four
137.1 kmph this time, length ball and about a foot outside off, Hayden lets that through to the keeper
He has the orange cap, and shows the form that helped him get it, first ball on his pads, tucked away with ease through midwicket for a boundary
Vijay gets off the mark by guiding a length ball with the angle towards third man
on target this time, full on middle, 136.3 kmph, watchfully pushed towards midwicket by Vijay
Nannes charges in, and starts off with a wide down the legside

the last ball runs away for a streaky four, a short delivery takes a top edge to hum over the keeper, that doesn't matter though, Chennai have won by 18 runs to keep the fight for places in the points table very tight
slower ball outside off, Mishra tries to slog it out of the park, but gets beaten
Mishra gets a six, short ball from Balaji, the big heave connects and the ball sails over the square leg boundary
slightly wider, Mishra sticks to his swing-at-everything routine, and again he doesn't get bat on ball
Balaji keeps it in the channel outside off, Mishra swings and doesn't connect again

another wicket goes down, the fat lady is starting to sing, Morkel sends down a full ball on middle and off, Bhatia gives himself room and hacks at it, L Balaji runs across from cover to pouch the mishit
another swing, another miss, the ball sails just over the offstump, Delhi are out of it
Bhatia takes a leaf out of the Mishra book and swipes at it, he is also beaten, this is turning out to be a great over from Morkel
full on middle, Mishra gets across his stumps and flicks it behind square leg for a single
length ball, just outside off, Mishra doesn't bother with seeing the ball and puts in a wild heave, misses the ball completely
fullish ball outside off, driven toward mid-off for a single
Jakati completes a superb spell with another wicket, Sangwan is bowled, he swings and misses, and the stumps are knocked back, Delhi are trying to match Chennai for late collapse
whipped away from middle wicket, but a diving stop at short midwicket means it another dot ball
defended back down the pitch, dot ball
gets a single in front of point

Not very costly at all it turns out as Karthik holes out off the very next ball, a sweep from Karthik gets a top edge and it hovers to Murali at midwicket, who makes no misjudgment. Murali knows it's a big wicket, he jumping around for joy after taking the catch

oh, a poor piece of fielding from Badrinath, Karthik lofted it to long-off, Badrinath came charging in but he comes in too much and the ball sails over his head and goes one bounce over the boundary, that's Karthik's half-century

played with soft hands towards backward point, Bhatia is sent back by Karthik, the throw is fired in and the bails are taken off just as Bhatia makes a despairing dive, third umpire is called for but Bhatia has made his ground
length ball which is defended off the front foot by Bhatia
the doosra does the trick for Murali, it was full and flat and Manhas was eying the midwicket boundary, is beaten and offstump is knocked back
goes for a sweep, misses the ball completely, like Warner, but he's kept his feet firmly grounded
turns a length ball towards midwicket, straight to the fielder
Karthik swings the first ball of the over towards long-on for a single
he pushes his first ball towards extra cover, but there's not enough time to get a single

Warner was onto the front foot, and put everything behind a heave to get the ball to midwicket, he missed the ball and couldn't get back in time before Dhoni whips off the bails, third umpire confirms Warner's on his way
length ball again from Jakati, Karthik punches it down to long-on for a single
tried to reverse-sweep, gets an inside edge towards short leg
Smash! slightly short from Jakati, Karthik gets onto the backfoot, gets his front foot out of the way, pulls it powerfully, one bounce over the midwicket rope
Jakati starts with a length ball angling to leg, worked to the on side by Karthik
slower ball, overpitched on legstump, sensibly worked away towards midwicket for a single
Warner flatbats a short ball powerfully back down the pitch, umpire Daryl Harper was running for cover as that ball smashed into the stumps
fullish on middle, Karthik flicks it away to square leg for a single
short and wide, Warner drags it from way outside offstump towards long-on, the single gets his half-century, has he done enough to get a place when Sehwag comes back?
full and on middle and leg, Karthik squeezes it out towards extra cover for a single
a paddle sweep to a medium-pacer, that was very cheeky but it came off, he went down on one knee and swept that back of a length ball for a boundary
Warner tries to run if off the open face to third man but gets beaten by the turn
Karthik gets himself another single wide of square leg, no need to try anything adventurous after getting two fours in the over already
in the slot, hammered along the ground by Warner, but placement isn't too good, only a single to long-on
on the pads, nudged to square leg for a single by Karthik
this time off the backfoot, Delhi are getting a move on, Karthik rocks back and crunches it through cover for another four
another boundary for Karthik, gets onto the front foot and doesn't allow the ball to pitch, slices it over cover for a boundary
rounds off the over with a glide to third man for a single to retain the strike

another pull, another six, this wasn't as cleanly struck as Warner's, in fact Murali who was sprinting around at the midwicket boundary just about managed to get a hand on it but could only tip it for a six
this time he is content to push it towards mid-off for a single
Warner seems to have realised the required rate is over 10, he picks up the slower delivery from Oram early and hammers the ball in to the crowd behind the midwicket boundary
back of a length on the pads, Warner gets in the backfoot and pushes it back to the bowler
starts off with a back of a length ball on offstump, Warner looks to power it through the off side but can't beat the fielder at extra cover
length ball allows Karthik to get under it, he slices it over cover, Jacob Oram runs across and puts in  a dive to try stop it but to no avail, that's another boundary for Karthik
this time he gets a run, driving an overpitched ball down to long-off for a single
tries to lash it through the covers but the placement is poor, and that's yet another dot ball
Warner punches it powerfully towards midwicket but Hayden puts in a diving stop to cut off any runs
tight line from Balaji, on offstump, Karthik opens the face to run it down to third man
starts off with a length ball on middle and off, drilled through covers by Warner, man's there in the deep though
again Karthik backs away to an outside off delivery, this time he guides the ball to short third man
a touch short from Raina, Karthik slog sweeps that to the midwicket boundary, Delhi need at least one of those every over
a bit of width and Karthik gives himself room to cut but misses the ball
flat and quick, just outside off, Warner dabs it to backward point
played uppishly towards cover by Warner, lands safely and gets him a couple
punched back to the bowler by Karthik, and that dot ball signals the strategic time-out
pushed gently towards mid-off and Warner gets a single
Warner goes for a powerful pull but gets a thick inside edge onto his boot, keeper does the fielding
nudged off his pads towards square leg for a single
Karthik fancies his chances on the backfoot, he was looking to cut an outside off delivery but was beaten by Murali's quicker one
down the track and pushed to long-off for an easy single
and Jakati is in the firing line again, this time he can't make a clean stop and the batsmen take a single
that would have hurt Jakati, a full toss and Warner was down the track and gives it a full-blooded swing, it hits the bowler on the bounce, saves some runs for the team Jakati
a delicate paddle sweep from offstump fetches Karthik a single
slightly tossed up, Warner waits on the backfoot and punches it to long-off
Warner shows us his power, it was too short and wide, Warner rocked back and hammered it through the cover
Karthik tries to paddle sweep a middle-stump ball, a mishit ends up flying towards short third man
Warner stuck on the backfoot to a full ball turning into him, he manages to defend it back onto the pitch though
Karthik's been looking to get his front leg out of the way and smack it over midwicket, doesn't get hold of this one, and it rolls towards mid-off
drilled down to long-off, just a single though
Warner backs away and slaps an outside-off delivery against the spin to long-on
turned towards square leg for a single
Karthik slogs the first ball towards midwicket, nearly reaches Vijay at deep midwicket but lands short of a diving Vijay
shout for lbw but that was angling down the leg side, thuds into Karthik's pads and dribbles to short fine leg
cracker of delivery accounts for Dilshan, a bit of flight pitching on leg and turns past Dilshan's forward defence to hit middle and off, that's a delivery Jakati will remember for a long time
Dilshan moves across the stumps and plays it with soft hands towards mid-on, superb running from the batsmen get them a couple
arm ball hurtling towards leg, Dilshan tries to make room but can't get the ball away
flat this time, fullish outside off, tapped towards cover by Dilshan
flighted, full on legstump, Dilshan backs away and plays it towards mid-on
nicely-timed off drive to a fullish ball from Warner, but so well timed that there's no time to take a single
on the pads, really not where you want to be bowling when fine leg is in the circle, Warner flicks it off his thigh over Murali at fine leg for a boundary
short from Tyagi, Dilshan looks for the pull again, manages to get it towards mid-on for a single
much better from Tyagi, a bit of outswing and the ball goes through to the keeper

Dilshan joins the party, he's been in terrific form all tournament, this ball was fractionally short, Dilshan brings out the pull - his favourite stroke - and that flies low over the midwicket boundary
punched to extra cover by Dilshan, misfield by Oram allows the batsmen a single
fullish outside off, superb timing from Warner, no power in the shot but it finds the gap in the covers, and the batsmen get three before the fielders cut it off at the boundary
Morkel slips in the bouncer, Warner guides it along to the square leg boundary, that's his third four in a row, what a response to losing two big wickets
no edge this time, that screamed right out of the middle of the bat, a touch shorter, Warner was onto the backfoot and crunched it through cover
much fuller this time, just outside off, Warner throws his bat at it, gets a bit of an edge but there's enough behind the shot to take it to the point boundary
short of length from Morkel, pitching on middle and going towards leg, Warner works it away to midwicket
short ball this time from Tyagi, Dilshan goes for the pull, gets a thick inside edge back to the bowler
that was 138.2kmh, a hint of swing for Tyagi, pitching on middle and spearing towards Warner's pads, it dribbles away towards square leg for a single
short and just outside off, Dilshan cuts it into the ground and towards backward point for a single which gets him off the mark
length ball on offstump, punched towards mid-on by Tillkaratne Dilshan

Another big blow, AB de Villiers continues the IPL trend of golden ducks, this was a beauty from Tyagi, pitching on back of a length around middle, de Villiers tries to defend but it held its line and crashed into the stumps, Tyagi's on a hat-trick

a blinder from Raina gets rid of Gambhir, it was a poor delivery, short and wide, Gambhir lashed at it and it flew towards point, seemingly headed for the boundary, but Raina dives full length to his right and plucks it with one hand, that ball was screaming
fuller this time, just outside offstump, Warner gets it away past point, enough time for the batsmen to take two
Morkel reverts to the outside-off line, Gambhir opens the face and dabs the ball to third man for an easy single
short ball on legstump, a controlled pull from Gambhir fetches him a boundary past square leg, easy for Gambhir, he didn't try to get too much power behind that
length ball on middle, Warner gets on the backfoot and turns it towards wide mid-on for a single
another tip-and-run single for Gambhir, just behind point
half volley wide outside off, Gambhir misses out, he launched into that one but straight to the fielder at short cover, no run
nice timing from Warner, just a push off the backfoot and it finds the gap past extra cover, gets himself two runs
keeps it in the channel outside off, Warner goes for the on-drive, doesn't beat the man at mid-on
similar delivery from Tyagi, defended off the back foot by Warner
back of a length, on offstump, Gambhir tips it towards point and takes a quick single, he's so good at this

free-hit, poor delivery but he gets away with it, short down the leg side, Warner was eying the midwicket boundary, was through the shot too early, and it canons off the back of the bat towards short third man
no-ball from Tyagi, full on middle and leg, tapped to the offside and the batsmen take a quick single
Good start by Tyagi, back of a length around offstump, Gambhir looks to glide it to third man, but plays inside the line
hits a length just outside off and Gambhir steers to backward point
short of a length outside leg stump, Gambhir hops up and taps it
back of a length, much better angle too, and it beats Gambhir
don't bowl there, man, thats how he makes a living! Albie pitches it even fuller on the pads and Gambhir plays it late, with the swing, clipping it away past square
fuller on the stump and driven uppishly to mid-on
swing first up but too much! Albie pitches it just outside leg stump and gets some movement in, Gambhir mistimes the big flick and middle and off stumps were visible to umpire Harper says nope
